requirements.text: The system shall maintain a borrowing limit of 5 books per member, allowing a temporary increase to 6 under specific resource assessments.
The system shall automatically track and notify members of overdue books via digital notifications with a fallback mechanism to ensure reliability.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of failure.
The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The system shall process book returns within 1 second while ensuring thorough security checks.
The system shall send overdue notifications to members within 24 hours of the due date.
The system shall log all transactions, including borrow and return actions, for audit and accountability purposes.
The system shall implement role-based access control for librarians and members.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
The system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.
The system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.

Processing speed and security checks are balanced in the final requirements.
Both notification methods must ensure security and effectiveness.
